name: GPU Ray Casting with Depth Peeling and Tile-Based Subdivision
aliases: Bernardon et al. GPU Ray Casting
definition: An improved GPU-based ray caster using a compact 2D texture representation, tile-based screen subdivision, and depth-peeling for non-convex meshes.
summary: This GPU ray casting method renders non-convex unstructured grids by combining tile-based screen subdivision with per-tile depth peeling to avoid convexification and reduce fragment processing overhead.
